paragraphs: Rami bar Rav Yod, [Taanit 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.22b.15-16). Hyman proposes the same reading in [Shabbat 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.32b.8).[^1]

notes.text: Taanit gives Rami bar Rav Yod twice, and [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Taanit.22b.15.1) explains that Yod was the sage’s name. The Shabbat parallel to the first teaching gives Rami bar [Chama] in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3235&lang=en) cites the Taanit reading and Rashi’s explanation.
